meta.title: An unknown round sent as "TradeRequest" crashes every chats request

direct.expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today the before-action resolve_module_params calls nil.event_group_id after TradeRequest.find_by_id returns nil (chats_controller.rb:427-429) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 422 code 533 'Project does not exist.'.
